# Operation Emberglass Scope and ROE

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This assessment, organization, and every value below are fictional.

## Objective

Evaluate whether a standard domain user could reach the internal archive
service and demonstrate a controlled path to directory replication rights.

## In scope

- Domain: `emberglass.internal`
- Network: `10.77.24.0/24`
- Web application: `https://portal.emberglass.internal`
- Primary contacts: `security.lead@emberglass.internal`

## Constraints

- No denial of service or persistence
- No broad password spraying
- No full directory credential dump
- Use marker files for upload testing
- Remove temporary routes, files, and attributes after validation

## Data handling

Operational notes may contain fictional credentials and hashes for DECON
testing. Sanitized exports must preserve host relationships while replacing
the original values consistently.
